verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code review platform that does run coding agents (one-click fixes pushed to PR branches, an MCP server for external agents), so a buyer could fairly ask about a session-management workspace. However, the evidence never documents a unified workspace for running or managing multiple agent-driven coding sessions. The closest items are adjacent features: per-comment fixes, MCP access for an external agent, and analytics on AI coding usage. None of these provides multi-session agent management.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace
